description: Ask the studio's knowledge graph a question in a trader's words (how do I backtest, what does C039 mean, the Pine twin of ta.crossover, what comes after the gate). It answers the nodes that hold the rule: cubicle.script concepts, the runner's functions, series and truths with their Pine names, every diagnostic code, every studio tool, the seven desk steps, the templates and our research scripts with their evidence. Each node carries `act`: the tool (with arguments) or the deck place that does it, so take that action next instead of describing it. Pass `id` (fn:ema, code:C039, step:gate) for one node. Read only, free, needs no sign-in.

id.description: one node id instead, such as fn:ema, code:C039, concept:gate or concept:live

q.description: the question, in the trader's words

name: studio_knowledge
